question: Does the frozen field flow leave anomalous non-Gaussian or spatial structure in its inferred noise that its scalar likelihood and energy miss?
motivation: R5 sparse statistics on 72 arbitrary latent axes did not clearly improve detection. The field model has 32651 observed latent pixels with a natural spatial geometry; whiteness tests have a different and physically motivated representation here.
models: The two existing unconditional R2 field flow-matching networks. No neural retraining, no per-map weight adaptation.
numerical_pilot: Extract terminal latent fields using the same deterministic masked Heun ODE, omitting the divergence computation only.
Verify an analytic Gaussian flow and agreement with the existing 32-step energy implementation.
Compare 16, 32 and 64 steps on fixed normal validation maps before looking at synthetic performance.
Verify singleton/order/chunk invariance, finite observed-pixel checks and insensitivity to missing-pixel content.
statistics: Raw terminal energy, as an existing-score control
Anderson-Darling normality statistic over observed latent pixels
Shape-only Anderson-Darling after within-map centering and scaling
Coefficient of variation of the mean-centered, masked field's Fourier power, excluding DC
Sum of squared nonperiodic correlations at spatial offsets (0,1), (1,0), (0,4), (4,0), weighted by valid pair counts
mask: Use exactly the existing pooled support. Holes and geometry affect the Fourier statistic; compare to the same masked Gaussian control and empirical normal maps, not an unqualified theoretical CV=1 threshold.
scope_of_claim: An adaptation inspired by SITN, not a reproduction of its image experiments or theoretical false-positive guarantees. Prior approximation, mask geometry, sample dependence and empirical calibration matter.
selection: If numerical checks pass, freeze the statistic definitions before normal-only calibration and reused synthetic diagnostics. Any subsequent change is recorded separately.
public_test: No reads for development or selection. Candidates 04 through 09 remain unchanged.
resources: Authorized erdos-3242 lab only; RAM-backed caches, no GCS or production mutations.
